stories.title: Half of Hong Kong’s public bodies omit emissions data, green group finds
stories.summary: Half of Hong Kong’s government departments and public bodies have not disclosed their greenhouse gas emissions data and some calculations have been based on outdated information, a green group has found. The findings from The Green Earth have prompted calls for stronger carbon reporting and the setting of reduction targets across the public sector to align with the city’s goal of achieving carbon neutrality before 2050. stories.title: Kiev’s "exotic proposals" for peace merely imitation of peacemaking — envoy
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 24. Vladimir Zelensky only needs even more money from the West, not a settlement in Ukraine, Russian Foreign Ministry Ambassador-at-Large for the crimes of the Kiev regime. Rodion Miroshnik told Izvestia, adding that Kiev’s "exotic proposals" for peace are merely a sham intended to simulate peacemaking efforts. Specifically, he noted that European countries "have already promised Kiev colossal sums of money" to continue the conflict. "In fact, Zelensky and his clique have no need for a settlement, what they need is money," Miroshnik said. "Their ‘exotic proposals’ for peace are merely a simulation of peacemaking efforts, devoid of any realistic steps whatsoever that would lead to a settlement," he stressed.
